non_residential_details.development_type: Change of Use with Extension(s) over 999sqm

description: AMENDED SCHEME: The retention and alteration (including limited, selective demolition) of Wallis House in association with the re-instatement of employment use (Class B1-business), the creation of a gallery (Class D1-non residential institutions), the provision of a health club (Class D2-assembly and leisure) and the introduction of residential use (Class C3-dwellinghouses) of the building.  The retention, alteration and extension of International House and its use as a restaurant (Class A3-restaurants and cafes) and incubator business units (Class B1-business).  The demolition of all other buildings on the site and redevelopment for mixed employment (Class A1-shops, A2-financial and professional services, A3-restaurants and cafes, A4-drinking establishments, B1-business and C1-hotels), community (Class D1-non residential institutions and D2-assembly and leisure) and private and affordable residential (Class C3-dwellinghouses) use, together with associated public and private open spaces, access roads, service areas, 1,045 car parking and landscaping.  The proposed buildings range from 4 to 10 storeys in height and a 25-storey tower
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - .
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, before the buildings are occupied. Any applications for variation shall be accompanied, inter alia, by overlay drawings provided by the applicant forcomparison with the permitted scheme.

Condition : 4 - A scheme of phasing and timetable of development (including for all hard and soft landscape areas and car and cycle parking spaces on the site) and timing of construction (including details of the arrangements for construction traffic including routes, access arrangements, hours of delivery and waiting areas) shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme, unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development above ground shall take place within each phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces hereby permitted (including public pedestrian and shared surfaces, associated ramps, steps, etc) for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Submissions shall be accompanied by overlay drawings provided by the applicant for comparison with the permitted scheme.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Supporting notes:
(a) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any materials already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 6 - No development above ground shall take place within each phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) until detailed drawings of the proposed balconies and balustrades, angled/saw tooth bay windows and privacy screens for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.  Submissions shall be accompanied by overlay drawings provided by the applicant for comparison with the permitted scheme.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Supporting notes:(a) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any detailed drawings already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 7 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority then the approval may only be taken as having been given if it is given expressly by reference to the relevant condition (and for the avoidance of doubt agreement expressed under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 shall not, alone, be taken as such an approval) and the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by that Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - With reference to the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005, the total floorspace for A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, C1, D1 and D2 uses shall not exceed 38,157sq.m Gross External Area.

Condition : 10 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 11 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - Before any plant and/or machinery is used within each phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3), it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme for the relevant phase that shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - The use hereby permitted for Shops (A1 Use Class) shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 7.00am to 11.00pm weekdays (Monday-Friday) and Saturday and 11.00am to 11.00pm on Sundays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11.00pm every day.

Condition : 14 - The parts of the development hereby permitted for Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or for Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9.00am to 11.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and on Saturdays, and 11.00am to 11.00pm on Sundays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11.00pm every day.

Condition : 15 - The uses hereby permitted for Financial and Professional Services (A2 Use Class) shall not be carried on outside the following times: 8.00am to 6.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8.00am to 6.00pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - No amplified or other music shall be played in any premises hereby permitted for use either as Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) outside the following times: 11.00am to 11.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays), Saturdays and Sundays.

Condition : 17 - The parts of the development hereby permitted for Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or for Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall be fitted with self-closing external doors unless otherwise approved, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.  No outside areas shall be used for A3 or A4 uses without the express approval, in advance and in writing, of the Local Planning Authority.  For the avoidance of doubt, there shall be no alterations, additions or improvement to the surface of the land or construction of any physical barrier without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - The use hereby permitted for a health club purpose within Wallis House shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 6.30am to 11.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8.00am to 10.00pm on Saturdays and Sundays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority, and all customers shall have left the premises by 11.00pm on weekdays and 10.00pm on Saturdays and Sundays.

Condition : 19 - The use hereby permitted for a health club purpose within Wallis House shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the scheme fully implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 20 - No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 22.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 21 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm on weekdays (Mondays to Fridays) and 8.30am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 23 - The development hereby permitted shall not be begun within each phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials (including details of the means and timing of collections and, in relation to proposed bin areas, access and pulling distance details) for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and no part of any phase within the development shall be occupied until the arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials associated with that phase has been completed.

Condition : 24 - The scheme of sound insulation for the residential accommodation shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the planning permission hereby given and no residential accommodation within each of the relevant phases (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) shall be occupied until the approved scheme of sound insulation for the relevant phase has been carried out.

Condition : 25 - Before any premises hereby permitted for use as either Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) opens to customers a scheme for the control of fumes and odours from the relevant premises, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing, and the scheme fully implemented in accordance with the approved details and must be permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 26 - The parts of the development for which D1 and D2 uses have been permitted shall not be first used until a scheme for the ventilation of the relevant premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and the scheme fully implemented in accordance with the approved details and must be permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 27 - No part of any phase within the development (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) shall be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the works for the relevant phase carried out as approved. 
(a)	The hard landscape details shall include: proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas including a corner-cutting path between Ealing and Great West Roads underneath Building 2; safety railings; refuse units; hard surfacing materials; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting, nest boxes for birds, bat box provision, works of art (e.g. that proposed to be attached to the elevations of Buildings 3 and 12) etc); notwithstanding Condition 2 above, the physical appearance of the piazza pavilions; proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage, power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); tree pits and method of preserving these against encroachment by service runs etc during construction and future management; retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant)
(b)	The soft landscape details shall include: planting plans including the planting of the roofs of the piazza pavilions (sedum); written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme.
Supporting notes:
(a) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.  
(b)	Submissions for the piazza pavilions shall be accompanied by overlay drawings p

Condition : 28 - No development for which planning permission is required, with the exception of the works comprised in Wallis House and International House, shall, unless the Council first approves otherwise in writing, take place within each phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) until details of earthworks for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with Network Rail, the Sewerage Undertaker and the Environment Agency).  These details shall include the proposed grading and mounding of land areas including the levels and contours to be formed, showing the relationship of proposed mounding to existing vegetation and surrounding land form, and the location and protection of tree pits against encroachment by hard landscaping and services (including mains supplies, foul and surface water drainage work, etc).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Supporting notes:
(a)	It should be noted that Network Rail are concerned about excavations within 10 metres of the boundary with the operational railway and will need to be assured that the construction of foundations and footings will not impact on the stability of the railway. 
(b) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 29 - No part of any phase in this development (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) shall be occupied until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan for the relevant phase indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment for the relevant phase shall be completed before the buildings in that phase are occupied (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details including all internal boundary treatments. 
Supporting notes:
(a)	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 30 - No part of any phase in this development (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) shall be occupied / brought into use until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a landscape management plan for the relevant phase, including long-term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas (other than small, privately owned, domestic gardens).  The landscape areas shall be managed and maintained in accordance with the approved landscape management plan, which shall be for a minimum of five years.
Supporting note:
(a) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 32 - If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective) then another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 33 - Before development for which planning permission is required, with the exception of the works comprised in Wallis House and International House, is commenced, details of the vehicle access points from Ealing Road, Clayponds Lane and the service road parallel to the Great West Road shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall not be occupied until the access arrangements have been completed in accordance with details approved by the Local Planning Authority (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority).

Condition : 34 - Before development above natural ground level commences (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park), with the exception of any works of demolition and the works comprised in Wallis House and International House (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority), details of sightlines at the points of access to the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the details.
Condition : 35 - There shall be no more than 1,045 car parking spaces provided on or under the site and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose.

Condition : 36 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority showing a total of 600 cycle parking spaces within the curtilage of the site.  These cycle parking spaces shall, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, be provided before first occupation of the buildings within each of the relevant phases and such spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 37 - Before any part of the development within any phase is occupied (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3), details for the relevant phase of vehicular and cycle access to and within the car park as well as plans and particulars for the management thereof (including widths and gradients of the ramps; location, type and operation of barriers to and within the car park; circulation space; allocation of disabled and other parking spaces with demonstration of the availability of adequate levels of spaces for visitors and servicing arrangements; lighting; CCTV; arrangements for the ventilation of the car park (including details of sound attenuation for any necessary mechanical plants and the standard of dilution expected); internal treatment of the car park and a demonstration that the layout and management are appropriate and safe for public use) shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and implemented in accordance with the details so approved.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 38 - Before any part of the development within any phase is occupied (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3), details of lux levels, direction and screening of any external and street lighting for the relevant phase shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  All lighting shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 39 - Before the relevant phase is commenced (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in advance and in writing with the Local Planning Authority), a scheme (including plans) indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to all parts of the development within the relevant phase (including details of the number and location of disabled parking bays and access ramp systems, and compliance with National Wheelchair Housing Association Group (NATWHAG) Wheelchair Housing Standards and Joseph Rowntree Foundation Lifetime Homes Standards) shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  For the avoidance of doubt, with the exception of the residential units in Wallis House, the scheme to be submitted shall indicate how 10% of the residential units hereby permitted shall be designed to be adaptable for residents who are wheelchair users, including how wheelchair adaptable housing shall be distributed throughout the development and cater for a varying number of occupants.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the relevant phase is brought into use (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority).
Supporting notes:
(a) 	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.  
(b)	In assessing any detail submitted the Council will assess compliance with National Wheelchair Housing Association Group (NATWHAG) Wheelchair Housing Standards (e.g. space planning needs).

Condition : 40 - The parts of the development for which A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, D1 and D2 uses have been permitted shall have access doorways with a minimum clear width of 900mm and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground or floor level as relevant.

Condition : 41 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced (or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) details of the standing space(s) and bus stop(s) off the central 'piazza' shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the  standing space(s) and bus stop(s) constructed in accordance with the approved plans.
Supporting note:
In assessing any detail submitted the Council will consult Transport for London.

Condition : 42 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:
(a)	The site shall be investigated to identify the extent and nature of contamination.  A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the Local Planning Authority for comment.  The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.
(b)	A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval. 
Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied:
(c)	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
(d)	The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Supporting notes:
(a)	The full site investigation must include intrusive testing for soil and groundwater contamination, soil gasses, and leachate. The investigation shall be carried out at such points and at such depths as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  The tiered risk assessment shall include a site conceptual model, which identifies all potential pollutant linkages on the site.  Risk assessments must adhere to current UK guidance and best practice.
(b)	The scheme for decontamination shall provide details of how each potential pollutant linkage, as identified in the conceptual model, will be made safe.
(c)	In some instances the LPA may require work on site to be ceased whilst the nature of additional contamination is investigated fully.
(d)  	The validation report shall revisit the site conceptual model, and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme was carried out co

Condition : 43 - Before excavation work is commenced a detailed site investigation shall be carried out to establish if the site is contaminated, to assess the extent and nature of the contamination present, and to determine its potential for the pollution of the water environment.  The method and extent of this site investigation shall be agreed with the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of work.  Details of measures to prevent pollution of groundwater and surface water, including provisions for monitoring, shall then be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences.  The development shall then proceed in strict accordance with the measures approved.
Supporting note:
In assessing any detail submitted the Council will consult the Environment Agency.

Condition : 44 - Development, with the exception of the works comprised in Wallis House and International House, shall not commence until details of surface water source control measures and details of foul and surface water drainage works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the agreed measures and works carried out.   Supporting notes:
(a)	Additional or increased flows of surface water must not be discharged onto Network Rail land or into Network Rail's culverts or drains.
(b)	In assessing an detail submitted the Council will consult the Sewerage Undertaker, the Environment Agency and Network Rail.

Condition : 45 - Development shall not commence until impact studies of the existing water supply infrastructure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The studies should determine the magnitude of any new additional capacity required in the system and a suitable connection point.
Supporting note:
In assessing any detail submitted the Council will consult Thames Water.
Condition : 46 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground or within 10 metres of the boundary of the operational railway.

Condition : 47 - No excavation or remedial works shall take place until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological work in accordance with a written scheme of investigation (including a watching brief and the timetable for the investigation) which has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  This may build upon the archaeological desk based assessment submitted with and in support of the development hereby permitted.  The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the approved programme of archaeological work, unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with English Heritage).  Should significant archaeological remains be encountered in the course of the initial field evaluation, an appropriate mitigation strategy, which may include archaeological excavation or areas of preservation in situ, is likely to be necessary.
Supporting note:
In assessing any detail submitted the Council will consult English Heritage.

Condition : 48 - No development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park), with the exception of the works comprised in Wallis House and International House, shall take place until wind tunnel tests (including details of mitigation measures and the timetable for mitigation measures to be carried out) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved details and must be permanently retained in full working order thereafter.
Supporting notes:
(a)	The detail to be submitted may build upon the work by BMT Fluid Mechanics Limited submitted with and in support of the development hereby permitted.  
(b)	The wind tunnel tests must examine the areas identified by the external consultant who the Local Planning Authority engaged to review the work by BMT Fluid Mechanics Limited submitted with and in support of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 49 - Any scaffold that is to be constructed adjacent to the railway shall be erected in such a manner that at no time will any poles or cranes over-sail or fall onto the railway.  All plant and scaffolding must be positioned such that in the event of failure it will not fall onto Network Rail land.
Supporting note: 
This is particularly important given the overhead electric power lines adjacent to the site.

Condition : 50 - No development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park), with the exception of the works comprised in Wallis House and International House, shall take place until a method statement for demolition works occurring within 10m of the boundary of the operational railway, within 10m of any listed building and/or to any listed building has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Supporting note:In assessing any detail submitted the Council will consult Network Rail.

Condition : 51 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place on Building 1 (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until detailed drawings of Building 1 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 52 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place on Building 18 (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until detailed drawings of Building 18 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 53 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the residential accommodation within Wallis House and floor plans and elevational drawings for Buildings 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12 and 16 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval. 
Supporting note:
(a)	The detail submitted must include an assessment of whether living room and bedroom windows would meet the daylighting standard set by Building Research Establishment guidance and BS 8206: 1992.
(b)	Any such approval would be subject to a condition requiring obscure glazing to not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
(c)	Should the applicant seek and the Council, as Local Planning Authority, agree to discharge this condition on a phased basis, the Council will, in assessing any detail submitted, have regard to how the proposal would relate to buildings in other phases.

Condition : 54 - The windows formed in the flank elevations of Buildings 13 and 15 of the development hereby permitted (as shown on drawing no. A1677 SK408 P1 entitled "Buildings 13 and 15v Glazing Amendments" and dated Dec '05 and received 6 December 2005) shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 55 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the affordable residential accommodation hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval. 
Supporting note:
Should the applicant seek and the Council, as Local Planning Authority, agree to discharge this condition on a phased basis, in assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 56 - Construction work in any phase of the development (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) (as shall have been approved under Condition 3) shall not begin until a scheme for protecting the residential units in that phase and adjacent phases from noise has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority; all works which form part of an approved scheme shall be completed before any residential unit in that phase is first occupied and all measures in the scheme shall be implemented for the duration of the construction work (whether in that phase or adjacent phases) in accordance with the scheme.  Any scheme proposed should conform to BS5228 (1992/1997) - Code of Practice for the control of Noise or Constructions and Open Sites.

Condition : 57 - The parts of the development for which A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, D1 and D2 uses have been permitted shall not be first used until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 58 - A scheme demonstrating how a 20mph on-site speed restriction, for all vehicles used in association with the proposed development, shall be achieved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with that approved scheme.  The scheme shall be submitted, approved and implemented before any part of the development within any phase (phasing as shall have been approved under Condition 3) is occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in advance and in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 59 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place on Building 12 (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority) until detailed drawings of Building 12 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
Condition : 60 - There shall be no amalgamation of any of the A1 units without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 61 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 62 - Notwithstanding Condition 2, before any premises hereby permitted for use as Retail (A1 Use Class), Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) opens to customers, the detailed design of the shop front for that premises shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 63 - The use of the basement car park shall not commence until details of the location, type and appearance of all the directional signage in the basement car park for pedestrians (including the disabled) to the lifts have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Supporting note:
Should the applicant seek and the Council, as Local Planning Authority, agree to discharge this condition on a phased basis, in assessing any detail submitted the Council will have regard to any details already approved and how the proposal would relate to these.

Condition : 64 - The premises hereby permitted for use as Retail (A1 Use Class), Restaurants and Cafes (A3 Use Class) or Drinking Establishments (A4 Use Class) shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises and shall not extend to the delivery of food and/or drink to customers by vehicle unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 65 - The parts of the development for which A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, D1 and D2 uses have been permitted shall not be first used until details of measures to prevent light spill from the illumination of the interior of the premises have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
